--- split and join
on t(x, d)
    set saved to AppleScript's text item delimiters
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to d
    set parts to text items of x
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "-"
    set joined to parts as text
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to saved
    return joined
end t
--- replace text handler
on replaceText(theText, searchString, replacementString)
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to searchString
    set theItems to every text item of theText
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to replacementString
    set theText to theItems as string
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to ""
    return theText
end replaceText
--- trim handler
on trim(s)
    repeat while s begins with " "
        set s to text 2 thru -1 of s
    end repeat
    repeat while s ends with " "
        set s to text 1 thru -2 of s
    end repeat
    return s
end trim
--- substrings
on t(s, n)
    return {text 1 thru n of s, text (n + 1) thru -1 of s, text -n thru -1 of s, characters 1 thru n of s as text, (characters n thru -1 of s) as string, text 1 thru ((length of s) - 1) of s, text (offset of "x" in s) thru -1 of s, s's text 2 thru 3}
end t
--- text building in loop
on t(l)
    set out to ""
    repeat with i from 1 to count of l
        set out to out & (item i of l)
        if i < (count of l) then set out to out & ", "
    end repeat
    return out
end t
--- character codes
on t(s)
    return {id of s, character id 65, character id {72, 105}, string id 97, (id of character 1 of s) + 1, ASCII number of s, ASCII character 66, (ASCII number s) - 32}
end t
--- case conversion by shell
on upper(s)
    return do shell script "echo " & quoted form of s & " | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'"
end upper
--- text comparisons under considering
on t(a, b)
    considering case
        set x to a is b
    end considering
    ignoring case and diacriticals
        set y to a is b
    end ignoring
    considering numeric strings
        set z to a < b
    end considering
    ignoring white space, punctuation and hyphens
        set w to a contains b
    end ignoring
    return {x, y, z, w}
end t
--- words and paragraphs
on t(s)
    set n to 0
    repeat with w in words of s
        set n to n + (length of w)
    end repeat
    repeat with p in paragraphs of s
        if (contents of p) is not "" then set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    return {n, count of words of s, word 1 of paragraph 2 of s, last word of first paragraph of s, character -1 of word -1 of s}
end t
--- string containment
on t(s)
    return {s contains "a", s does not contain "b", s starts with "c", s ends with "d", "e" is in s, "f" is not in s, s is "", s is not "", (length of s) = 0, (count of s) > 3, s = "g" or s = "h"}
end t
--- text with special characters
on t()
    return "line1" & return & "line2" & linefeed & tab & "x" & quote & "q" & quote & space & "\\" & "/" & "é" & "—" & "…"
end t
--- unicode and long strings
on t()
    set a to "ÀÉÎÕÜ ßø 中文 日本語 한국어 עברית العربية 😀🎉"
    set b to "a very long string with many words to make sure that a longer literal is stored and read back the same way without any loss of characters at all, including the last one."
    return {a, b, length of a, length of b}
end t
--- number to text
on t(n)
    return {n as text, n as string, "" & n, n & "", (n as integer) as text, (n / 3) as text, (round n) as text, n div 1 as text, text -2 thru -1 of ("0" & n)}
end t
--- text to number
on t(s)
    try
        return s as number
    on error
        try
            return s as integer
        on error
            return 0
        end try
    end try
end t
--- text item delimiters list
on t(s)
    set text item delimiters to {",", ";", " "}
    set parts to text items of s
    set text item delimiters to ""
    return parts
end t
--- offset idioms
on t(s, sub)
    set p to offset of sub in s
    if p is 0 then return s
    if p = 1 then return text ((length of sub) + 1) thru -1 of s
    return (text 1 thru (p - 1) of s) & (text (p + (length of sub)) thru -1 of s)
end t
--- quoted form and posix
on t(p)
    set q to quoted form of POSIX path of p
    set r to POSIX path of (p as alias)
    set s to (POSIX file r) as text
    set u to POSIX file (r & "/x") as alias
    return {q, r, s, u, quoted form of r, r's quoted form}
end t
--- linefeeds in literals
on t()
    return "first
second
	third"
end t
--- empty and whitespace strings
on t()
    return {"", " ", "  ", "	", "
", " a ", "\"", "'"}
end t
--- text class tests
on t(x)
    if class of x is text then return 1
    if class of x is string then return 2
    if class of x is in {text, string, Unicode text} then return 3
    if x's class is integer or x's class is real then return 4
    return 0
end t
--- reverse string
on t(s)
    return (reverse of characters of s) as text
end t
--- padding
on pad(n, w)
    set s to n as text
    repeat while (length of s) < w
        set s to "0" & s
    end repeat
    return s
end pad
--- concatenation chains
on t(a, b, c)
    return a & b & c & "x" & 1 & 2.5 & true & {a} & {b, c} & (a & b) & (1 + 2) & (a as text) & -1
end t
--- text in records and lists
on t(s)
    return {name:s, parts:{s, s & "2"}, size:length of s, flag:s is "", nested:{inner:s & "x"}}
end t
